notes: Held-out graph-routing corpus. Distinct synthetic vocabulary (ProjectC/ProjectD, marlin/osprey/gantry) from retrieval-eval.json so no case shares a memory with the tuning set. Relevance labelled by intent BEFORE any selective-expansion results were produced (2026-09-16). Cases are built to probe the candidate filter (active-only, outbound-only, link-sentence overlap) from both sides: links that should be followed without any shared target token, links whose sentence merely mentions a prompt word, factual lookups vs how-to, exploratory questions, inbound-only and stale neighbours. Never add real project names.

memories.name: Marlin release procedure
memories.description: How a ProjectC marlin build is cut and shipped
memories.body:
**Why:** marlin ships weekly and a missed step blocks the whole train.

**How to apply:** tag the build, run the smoke pass, then ship. Shipping is blocked on the days listed in [[projectc_blackout_days]]. The signing key rotation is tracked in [[projectc_signing_rotation]].

memories.name: Blackout days
memories.description: Days when no ProjectC shipment may go out
memories.body:
**Why:** finance closes the books on these days.

**How to apply:** do not ship on a listed day; the next open day is fine.

memories.name: Signing key rotation
memories.description: Schedule for rotating the ProjectC signing key
memories.body:
**Why:** the key expires yearly.

**How to apply:** rotate in the first week of the quarter; nothing else changes.

memories.name: Marlin smoke pass
memories.description: What the marlin smoke pass checks before a ship
memories.body:
**Why:** the smoke pass catches the packaging regressions.

**How to apply:** run it on the tagged build only; the release steps are in [[projectc_marlin_release]].

memories.name: Osprey ingest pipeline
memories.description: How ProjectD osprey ingests partner feeds
memories.body:
**Why:** partner feeds arrive in three formats.

**How to apply:** normalise each feed, then load. A feed that fails validation is quarantined per [[projectd_quarantine_policy]]. Historical throughput numbers are in [[projectd_osprey_throughput_2024]].

memories.name: Quarantine policy
memories.description: How long a rejected osprey feed is held before deletion
memories.body:
**Why:** partners sometimes resend a corrected feed.

**How to apply:** hold a rejected feed for ten days, then delete.

memories.name: Osprey throughput 2024
memories.body:
**Why:** kept for the audit trail.

**How to apply:** nothing operational.

memories.name: Osprey alert routing
memories.description: Where osprey ingest alerts are sent
memories.body:
**Why:** alerts went to a dead mailbox once.

**How to apply:** route ingest alerts to the on-call channel; the pipeline itself is [[projectd_osprey_ingest]].

memories.name: Gantry calibration
memories.description: Calibrating the ProjectC gantry after maintenance
memories.body:
**Why:** the gantry drifts after any maintenance.

**How to apply:** run the calibration cycle twice. The old procedure for the previous gantry model is [[projectc_gantry_calibrate_v1]].

memories.name: Gantry calibration (previous model)
memories.description: Superseded calibration steps for the first gantry model
memories.body:
**Why:** the first model needed a manual offset.

**How to apply:** only when servicing the first model.

memories.name: Gantry spare parts
memories.description: Where ProjectC gantry spare parts are stocked
memories.body:
**Why:** the belt and the encoder wear out first.

**How to apply:** check stock before scheduling maintenance.

memories.name: Ledger export format
memories.description: Column layout of the nightly ledger export
memories.body:
**Why:** downstream parsers break on column changes.

**How to apply:** append columns only; never reorder.

memories.name: User prefers short PRs
memories.description: Keep pull requests under three hundred lines
memories.body:
**Why:** review quality drops with size.

**How to apply:** split anything larger.

memories.name: Never force-push shared branches
memories.description: Force-pushing a shared branch is forbidden
memories.body:
**Why:** it destroyed a reviewer's local work once.

**How to apply:** rebase locally, push a new branch.

cases.prompt: can we ship the marlin build today
cases.rationale: Whether a ship is allowed today depends on the blackout calendar, which shares no prompt token; it is reachable only through the release entry's link. The link sentence ('Shipping is blocked on the days…') overlaps the intent.

cases.prompt: which checks does the marlin release smoke pass run
cases.rationale: The release entry also links the signing-key rotation, which does not answer a question about smoke checks; that link's sentence has no overlap with the prompt.

cases.prompt: how long is a rejected osprey feed held
cases.rationale: A factual lookup answered by one entry; the ingest pipeline that links to it is context, not an answer, and the archived throughput figures are noise.

cases.prompt: what happens when an osprey feed fails validation
cases.rationale: The ingest entry's link sentence ('A feed that fails validation is quarantined…') overlaps the prompt and the quarantine policy completes the answer; the archived throughput link does not.
Overview intent; the archived 2024 throughput neighbour is not relevant and must not be surfaced by expansion.

cases.prompt: where do osprey ingest alerts go
cases.rationale: The alerts entry links OUT to the pipeline; the pipeline links nothing back. Expansion from the alerts seed along its outbound link would add the pipeline, which does not answer where alerts go.

cases.prompt: calibration steps for the previous gantry model
cases.rationale: The user explicitly asks for the previous model; the superseded entry is the answer even though it is demoted.

cases.prompt: run the gantry calibration after maintenance
cases.rationale: Current procedure only; the superseded previous-model link is noise for this intent even though its sentence mentions the old procedure.

cases.prompt: tell me what we know about the gantry
cases.rationale: Broad exploratory intent: both active gantry entries are relevant; the superseded one is not.

cases.prompt: when does the marlin signing key rotate
cases.rationale: Direct answer is the rotation entry. The release entry also matches 'marlin' and links the blackout calendar in a sentence about shipping; that sentence does not overlap this prompt, so expansion should add nothing.

cases.prompt: how do we roll back a shipped marlin build
cases.rationale: The store knows marlin releases but records nothing about rollback; nothing answers the intent. Expansion along the release entry's links would be pure noise.
No entry is about this; every mode must return nothing.

cases.prompt: can I reorder the ledger export columns
cases.rationale: Single unlinked reference entry; expansion has nothing to follow.

cases.prompt: should I force-push the shared branch to fix the history
cases.rationale: Standing feedback answers it; the PR-size preference is unrelated.
